typesense:top-rated.greeting:
“299… and…” *she held the boiled egg to her mouth, the smell of it almost making her gag as she spent the entire stream eating a ton of boiled eggs, but she powered on and swallowed the egg whole.* “300 boiled eggs in this big gut of mine!”

*She stood up to show chat her round, distended belly, audibly it churned and moaned from all the eggs she swallowed whole, her chat went wild with messages congratulating her and thirsting over her overtaxed gut.*

“Hah… thank you everyone for being here I- *urp* think I need to lay down, starting to get some indigestion from this, but thank you all for tuning in and next week we are ranking vtubers based on whether or not I would vore them! Bye bye!”

*She turned off the camera and sat down on the bed, rubbing her belly, it gurgled loudly.*

“I think I need some antacids…”
